home_faq_a1: No. Shaking sticks, casting moon blocks and reading verdicts are all free. If you want to go deeper, you can ask Yue Lao for an in-depth reading (HK$12 once, tax included): pay once, keep it forever, never auto-renews.
home_faq_a2: No sign-in is needed to draw a stick; what you draw stays on your own device. To save an in-depth reading or make a wish at the Wishing Pond, sign in with Google or an email verification code. No password is required.
home_faq_a3: A "no" cast means Yue Lao isn't answering this time. Pause, think again about what you want to ask, and feel free to come back in a few days.
home_faq_a4: Switch languages from the menu at the top right. The English site is a machine-translated draft still under review: interface, verdicts, readings and card meanings are in English, while stick verses keep their original Chinese with an English gloss.
home_faq_a5: A stick isn't a prophecy — it helps you think through what's on your mind. You've already read the free verdict; whether it rings true, you'll know.
home_faq_a6: The 100 Yuelao verses follow publicly circulated collections. Where a classical reference can be identified, it appears on that stick’s page; some entries do not have a reliable source attribution. Our free interpretations for relationship uncertainty, being single and reconciliation are site-written, not official temple guidance.
